name: @profile-as-code/cli
description: pasco — the profile-as-code CLI: init, validate, build, diff, status + partial refine (task template), check (offline rules M6–M8; catalog ships M3/M4), skills:install (prints the projection command). Consumes @profile-as-code/core; never re-implements load/drift/geo/compile.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/core build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/markdown build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-github-readme build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-github-org build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-kofi build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-buymeacoffee build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-liberapay build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-gumroad build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-payhip build && pnpm --filter @profile-as-code/renderers-hotmart build && tsup && node -e "process.platform !== 'win32' && require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/index.js', 0o755)"
